title: I hired an illustrator to draw my house. Now it's my Home Assistant dashboard
why_read: A fun personal project combining custom art with Home Assistant, mostly of interest to smart-home hobbyists rather than general engineers.
analysis: This is a home automation hobby project where someone commissioned custom artwork of their house to use as an interactive dashboard background. It is creative and well-executed but represents a niche, cosmetic use case rather than a technical breakthrough. There may be some useful detail on how they wired illustration regions to live Home Assistant entity states. Mostly appeals to smart-home enthusiasts and UI tinkerers.
